spec.title: Read latency
spec.description:
Query-frontend `/prometheus/api/v1/*` endpoints.
- `querier avg` is the evaluation inside them; its gap below `avg` is the scheduler queue and the frontend hand-off.

spec.title: Samples received / sec
spec.description:
Samples accepted across all tenants, native histograms included.
- The number is the latest rate.

spec.title: Discarded samples
spec.description: `Writes · Discarded by reason and tenant` splits them.

spec.title: Error ratio
spec.description:
Server faults as a share of all requests.
- gRPC handlers report a status name, so `Internal`, `Unavailable` and `Unknown` count alongside 5xx.

spec.title: Bytes received
spec.description:
Uncompressed request body accepted across all tenants.
- Remote write repeats every label set with every sample, so the bucket holds far less.

spec.title: Ingester latency
spec.description: The `/cortex.Ingester/Push` call the distributor makes into the ingester, part of every write; the rest of `Write latency` is the distributor's own validation.

spec.title: In memory
spec.description: Active series is the subset of in-memory series that received a sample recently.

spec.title: Discarded by reason and tenant
spec.description:
Samples dropped before storage.
- `too_far_in_future` is clock skew at the source against `creation_grace_period`.
- The out-of-order reasons would be accepted with `out_of_order_time_window` set.

spec.title: Queries / sec
spec.description:
Read traffic by API endpoint.
- `other` collects the `api/v1` routes outside the named list, such as `/status` and `/format_query`.

spec.title: Scheduler queue duration
spec.description:
Time a query waited for a querier.
- Past `max_outstanding_requests_per_tenant` outstanding, the scheduler answers `429`, counted in `Failed queries`.
- A p99 flat on 5 ms is the first bucket; the real value is below it.

spec.title: Index cache hit ratio
spec.description:
Hits over requests, per item type.
- The store-gateway consults the index cache only for queries that reach blocks, so a low count is normal.

spec.title: Time since last successful compaction
spec.description:
A climbing line means compaction stopped succeeding.
- A gap covers the time before the first success after a restart.

spec.title: Compaction jobs
spec.description:
Compaction runs per hour.
- `pending jobs`, on the right axis, is the peak queue depth read off the bucket index.

spec.title: Block garbage collection
spec.description: Deletions follow `compactor_blocks_retention_period`.

spec.title: Bytes sent
spec.description: Bytes written back to query callers, query-frontend routes only.

spec.title: Active series per tenant
spec.description:
The line is `max_global_series_per_user`, applied per tenant.
- Over it, samples are dropped with reason `per_user_series_limit`.

spec.title: Ingestion rate per tenant
spec.description: The `ingestion_rate` limit applies per tenant; samples over it are dropped with reason `rate_limited`.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description:
With `GOMEMLIMIT` set, the Go runtime collects harder as the heap approaches it.
- Read `next GC target` against `Go heap in use`.
- RSS sits above the heap: it also covers stacks, mmap'ed chunks and allocator overhead.

spec.title: Query fan-out
spec.description:
Range queries are split by time interval, then each split is sharded across series.
- The gap between the lines is the fan-out: one query can become `max_query_parallelism` × `query_sharding_total_shards` sub-queries, each its own request to the ingester and store-gateway.

spec.title: Local TSDB size
spec.description:
Disk used by the ingester's own TSDB blocks.
- Blocks stay until the shipper has uploaded them and the local retention window drops them.

spec.title: Cache hit ratio
spec.description:
Hits over requests, per cache.
- A cache asked a few hundred times swings with a single query; read the ratio against the request count beside it.

spec.title: Cache errors & skips
spec.description:
Cache operations the client could not complete, as counts per bucket; skips sit on the right axis.
- `failed` — the cache itself errored and the read fell through to the store.
- `skipped` — Mimir declined to cache the item, usually larger than `max-item-size`: a sizing signal, not a fault.

spec.title: Store-gateway local size
spec.description:
On-disk size under `bucket_store.sync_dir` of the blocks the store-gateway has open.
- Index headers are mmap'ed, so this drives RSS as well as disk.

spec.title: Rejected queries
spec.description: Queries refused for exceeding a per-query limit — fetched series, chunks, chunk bytes or estimated memory.

spec.title: Running versions
spec.description: A version live at any point in a bucket fills it, so two rows overlap across an upgrade.

spec.title: p99 latency
spec.description:
The client-facing paths: remote-write, OTLP and Influx pushes, and the Prometheus query API.
- The Writes and Reads tabs add the mean; the Routes tab has every route.

spec.title: Requests
spec.description:
All HTTP and gRPC routes, Mimir's own fan-out between query-frontend, querier, ingester and store-gateway included; the Routes tab attributes it.
- Failures are counts per bucket on the right axis, stacked by class.
- `canceled` is the caller hanging up: `499`, `Canceled`, `ERROR_CANCELED`.
- `server error` is 5xx and the gRPC fault statuses, the set `Error ratio` counts.

spec.title: Discarded samples by reason
spec.description:
`rate_limited` and the `per_user_*_limit` reasons mean a limit you control is clamping a tenant; the timestamp reasons are the sender's clock.
- `Writes · Discarded by reason and tenant` splits them by tenant.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description:
CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.
- Compaction and query evaluation are the two CPU-bound paths.

spec.title: Bytes per tenant
spec.description:
Accepted volume per tenant, uncompressed request body.
- Against the tenant's ingestion rate it gives the per-sample cost, which tracks how verbose its label sets are.

Every HTTP and gRPC route over the whole range, the component's internal hops included; long-lived `Loop` and `Tail` streams are left out.
- `Traffic` scales each row to itself; compare magnitudes in `Requests`.
- A stream's duration is how long the connection stayed open.
- p99 rests on the 5 ms first bucket for most routes; `Mean` separates them.
- On a route with a handful of requests, p99 is the slowest one.
- `Canceled` is the caller hanging up: `499`, `Canceled` or `ERROR_CANCELED`.
- `Server errors` is 5xx and the gRPC fault statuses, the set `Error ratio` counts.

spec.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (route, le) (rate(cortex_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route!~".*(Loop|Tail)"}[$__range])))
and on (route)
(sum by (route) (rate(cortex_request_duration_seconds_count{route!~".*(Loop|Tail)"}[$__range])) > 0)

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Sustained growth against a flat ingest and query rate is a leak.

spec.expr:
{syslog_id="docker/mimir"}
|= `$contains`
| detected_level =~ `$errors_only`
| drop hostname, job, project, service_name, syslog_id, systemd_unit, transport

topk(15, sum by (detected_level, msg) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/mimir"}
  | logfmt msg
  | msg != ``
[$__range])))

spec.title: Rejected series
spec.description:
Series named in remote-write rejections, with the sending agent and the Mimir error code.
- Mimir omits the instance for `err-mimir-too-far-in-future`.
- Some classes are logged sampled at `1/10`, so these are line counts and a lower bound on the samples lost.

spec.expr:
topk(20, sum by (series, instance, reason) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/mimir"}
  |= `err-mimir-`
  | logfmt err
  | label_format series=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*(?:series: '|is from series )([a-zA-Z_:][a-zA-Z0-9_:]*).*$" .err "${1}" }}`, reason=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*\\((err-mimir-[a-z-]+)\\).*$" .err "${1}" }}`
  | label_format instance=`{{ if contains "instance=" .err }}{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*instance=\"([^\"]+)\".*$" .err "${1}" }}{{ else }}{{ end }}`
  | series =~ `[a-zA-Z_:][a-zA-Z0-9_:]*`
[$__range])))

spec.title: Series created per tenant
spec.description:
Each new series holds head memory until the 2-hourly head compaction.
- Creation at a steady active count means short-lived label values.

spec.title: Head block cycle
spec.description:
Every 2 hours the ingester compacts its head into a block, truncates the WAL and ships the block to the object store.
- A cell counts each step per bucket, summed over tenants.
- Red on a step row is a missed cycle; on `failures` or `corruptions`, the event itself.
- A corruption in the WAL or the mmap-ed chunks is data loss on the local TSDB.
- Failed uploads leave blocks on local disk, out of the store-gateway's reach.

spec.expr: (sum(increase(cortex_ingester_tsdb_compactions_failed_total[$__interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(cortex_ingester_tsdb_wal_truncations_failed_total[$__interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(cortex_ingester_shipper_upload_failures_total[$__interval])) or vector(0))

spec.title: Object store by operation
spec.description:
Calls, time per call and failures per operation over the whole range, every component's client summed.
- Over a few hundred calls, p99 is the handful of slowest.
- The top bucket is 120 s, so a p99 there reads only "at least 120 s".

spec.title: Failed queries
spec.description:
Read API requests that did not answer 2xx, per bucket.
- `499` — the caller gave up before the answer.
- Other `4xx` — Mimir refused the query as invalid or over a limit; `Rejected queries` names the limit.
- `5xx` — Mimir failed the query.

spec.title: Object store operations / sec
spec.description: Rate per operation; failed operations as counts on the right axis.

spec.title: Blocks
spec.description: The bucket count is sampled over 15 minutes, so short-lived blocks fall between samples.

spec.title: Status
spec.description:
Share of failed requests on each path.
- gRPC handlers report a status name, which counts alongside 5xx.
- `Storage` is the share of object store operations that failed, across every component.

spec.expr:
((
    # gRPC handlers report a status name, not a 5xx code.
    sum(rate(cortex_request_duration_seconds_count{route=~"/distributor.Distributor/Push|/httpgrpc.*|api_(v1|prom)_push|otlp_v1_metrics|api_v1_push_influx_write", status_code=~"5..|Unknown|DeadlineExceeded|Unimplemented|Internal|Unavailable|DataLoss"}[$__rate_interval]))
    or
    # Handle the case no failure has been tracked yet.
    vector(0)
)
/
sum(rate(cortex_request_duration_seconds_count{route=~"/distributor.Distributor/Push|/httpgrpc.*|api_(v1|prom)_push|otlp_v1_metrics|api_v1_push_influx_write"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

((
    # gRPC handlers report a status name, not a 5xx code.
    sum(rate(cortex_request_duration_seconds_count{route=~"(prometheus|api_prom)_api_v1_.+", status_code=~"5..|Unknown|DeadlineExceeded|Unimplemented|Internal|Unavailable|DataLoss"}[$__rate_interval]))
    or
    # Handle the case no failure has been tracked yet.
    vector(0)
)
/
sum(rate(cortex_request_duration_seconds_count{route=~"(prometheus|api_prom)_api_v1_.+"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

spec.title: Write requests / sec
spec.description:
Push endpoints only: remote-write, OTLP and Influx.
- Failures are counts per bucket on the right axis; `client error` is a push Mimir rejected in whole or part, whose samples `Discarded by reason and tenant` counts.

spec.title: Write latency
spec.description: Push endpoints only: remote-write, OTLP and Influx.

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only warnings and errors in the log. Lines Loki cannot classify are kept — their level is unknown, not low.

spec.name: contains
spec.label: Contains
spec.description: Substring the log line must contain, on top of the Errors only switch. Matches are highlighted.
